rulings.item: divergence 1 (holds_wrongly) at t=0 ms: The road user points northeast and moves southwest with velocity [-0.7071066, -0.7071066] m/s. Its rearward component along the unit heading is approximately 0.999999744 m/s, below the 1 m/s motion tolerance, but the heading's micrometre-truncated normalization makes the body compute a rearward component greater than 1 m/s. — contract: fails, body: holds; contract: "Measured as the component of its velocity (kin.velocity, m/s, world frame) along its heading (kin.heading, unit vector) lying below the negative of the motion tolerance, the speed below which a sampled motion counts as none."
rulings.why: The contract measures the component along its heading by naming the atom kin.heading. That atom's contract states that a formula reads the heading as the unit vector times a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶. On the executed facts (heading [1, 1], velocity [-0.7071066, -0.7071066], tolerance 1 m/s), the component as kin.heading delivers it lies just past -1 m/s, so reading the contract through its named atom gives the body's verdict. — "a formula reads it normalised: divided by its larger absolute component, then by its length taken to a micrometre, so the vector read is the unit vector times a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶"
